Name: SEASONAL SVE CUTE NYAPU PORTRAIT RETEXTURES BY AHCUTEART
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[center][size=5][b]SEASONAL CUTE NYAPU PORTRAITS – RETEXTURES BY AHCUTEART[/b][/size][/center]
I adored Nyapu’s portraits and noticed while playing my mega-modded SDV that there were no seasonal portraits. Since Nyapu had no plans to do the seasonal portraits, I decided to retexture the portraits to match the Seasonal Cute Outfits for SVE. After receiving permission from Nyapu for the retextures, and some of the artist that worked on the original mod, I decided to share my work with everyone.

[b]THIS IS THE COMPLETED UPDATE!
[/b]
I finally redrew the characters and portraits for the few npcs I couldn't get permission to use from the original artists.


[b]IMPORTANT 3.1 UPDATE: [/b]Nyapu has a CP file for their SVE portraits. We've removed Nyapu's original files from our mod. So you will need BOTH this mod and Nyapu's new SVE CP mod for this to work correctly.
[i](Thank you Dolphinisnotafish for your help on this.)[/i]


[b][size=4]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/size][/b]
1.     [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]StardewValley Expanded[/url]
2.     [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal SVE Outfits Slightly Cuter[/url]
3.     [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu’s Portraits[/url]
4.     Drag CP folder into your Mods

NOTE: If you want "Vanilla" sprites follow the instructions for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5975]Seasonal SVE Outfit (Vanilla)[/url]. YOU CANNOT HAVE BOTH. Please choose either the Vanilla SVE or the Cute SVE sprite mod. Otherwise, the Vanilla SVE version will overwrite the Cute version.

[i]Optional Folder:  Replacement Portraits only if you don't want to use the CP file.[/i]

- First, Stardew Valley Expanded needs to be installed.

- Second, download the Seasonal Outfits Slightly CuterAesthetic CP file and put it in your mod folder.

- Third, download Nyapu’s Portraits Inspired by Dong. File should be (CP) Nyapu'sP(SVE1.15.6) and drag that into your mod folder unzipped.

- Lastly, Unzip the CP file and drag it into your Mods folder.


 
[b][b]NEW Features with DolphinisNotaFish CP:
[/b]
[/b][list=1]
[*]Added a Spirit's Eve overworld sprite for vanilla Gunther because the base mod seems to call for it.
[*]Fixed some outfit changes not covered by the base mod related to Martin's theater outfit.
[*]Alter and add some overlay images to Sophia portraits to make her "Older" version work correctly.
[*]Alesia actually seems to be a mistake on the Seasonal Cute mod. They set her Winter outfit as Indoor only, so her
portraits just reverts to
default when outdoor. DolphinisNotaFish corrected this. 
[*]Wizard Winter Outfit as indoor only. And, DolphinisNotaFish found, also Jadu,
Camilla, Jolyne and Isaac with the same error. DolphinisNotaFish enabled
them for Outdoor.
[*]Morris and Scarlett are temporary actors in some places/events, which uses their base portraits instead of the ones used by the Seasonal mod's appearance system. DolphinisNotaFish fixed this and edited the base portrait code of every other NPCs
[*]Removed duplicate NPCs "bug" in the movie theater.
[/list][b]

CREDITS:

BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art.
[i]HUGE thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for creating such an amazing CP mod![/i]
Thank you to all the artist that worked on the original Seasonal SVE Outfit mod that gave me permission to use their work.
[b]
[/b][i]If your curious what I am working on next please check out my social media page or my Nexus profile.
[/i]
